scope: synthetic harness evidence only; no model/financial acceptance

conventions.window: rolling 1260; each fit uses only sessions strictly before its forecast origin
conventions.realized: square of sum of constant-active-weight simple returns; zero selected-cash price shock
conventions.projection: cumulative conditional variance; zero mean/cross-day covariance approximation
conventions.loss: log(predicted cumulative variance) + realized squared active return / predicted variance
conventions.zero_active: exact zero variance/return; loss unavailable, never log(0) or a fake zero loss
conventions.simple_reference: full zero-mean sample covariance from identical training returns, constant daily
conventions.no_tuning: all portfolios, periods, references and diagnostics frozen before outcomes

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of chronological origin loss differences
uncertainty.interpretation: exploratory synthetic uncertainty; 12 origins do not establish model superiority

acceptance.software: exact window/order preservation, finite valid scores or explicit refusal, attribution/units reconciliation and immutable recovery
acceptance.model: no synthetic loss threshold grants real calibration, production settings, capacity or financial acceptance
acceptance.unsupported: retain requested dimensions and first failed stage; no limit increase, truncated universe or fallback
acceptance.actual_retained_union: unavailable: no qualified actual full-union inputs supplied
